dnd5e-hud-to-rule-them-all.settings.mate: Pay costly material components in gold

House rule: a spell that needs a component with a price ("a diamond worth 300+ GP") is cast without carrying it, as long as the character has that much money. Components the spell consumes are paid for; the others only have to be affordable. Applies to player characters' own spells, not to scrolls, wands or monsters.

dnd5e-hud-to-rule-them-all.materials.cue: Needs {cost} in the purse, nothing is spent — purse {purse}
dnd5e-hud-to-rule-them-all.settings.auto: Apply buff and healing effects to the targets

dnd5e only puts an Apply button on the chat card, which players can't use on creatures they don't own. With this on, the effects of utility and healing activities (Protection from Evil and Good, Bless, Shield, Rage) land on the chosen targets right away, tied to the caster's concentration. Effects behind a save or an attack roll keep the manual button. A GM must be online for creatures the caster doesn't own. With Midi QoL, only while Midi's own "Auto apply item effects" is off — otherwise Midi applies them.

dnd5e-hud-to-rule-them-all.settings.wild: Wild magic: surge check
When a wild mage casts a spell of 1st level or higher. A creature is a wild mage when it has a feature named "Wild Magic…", or when the gear dialog says so.
Off — no wild magic at all
Roll a d20, surge on a 1 (2014)
Roll a d20, surge on a 20 (2024)
Every spell surges
Manual — only from a macro (api.wildMagic.surge)
Wild magic: sorcerer spells only
Only spells the sheet attributes to the Sorcerer class can surge. Spells without a class always can.
Wild magic: apply surges on the caster automatically
Effects, healing, mana and coins that only touch the caster are applied the moment the surge is rolled. Spells, damage and anything that reaches other creatures stay a button on the card.
Wild magic: who sees the surge
A check that does not surge is always whispered to the GM.
Everyone
GM and the caster's player
Wild magic: mana attribute
Where a character's mana lives, for the surges that give or take it, e.g. system.resources.primary. Empty: a resource labelled Mana or Spell Points, then an item of that name with uses.
Wild magic: animations
Played through Sequencer from JB2A (Patreon or free) and PSFX. The preferred pack is searched first, the other one is the fallback. Without Sequencer nothing is played.
JB2A first, then PSFX
PSFX first, then JB2A
No animations
Wild magic: animation overrides
JSON from table entry to Sequencer database key, e.g. {"7": "jb2a.fireball.explosion.orange", "0": "psfx…"}. 0 is the burst on every surge; an empty string switches one off.
